title: Which formulation is stronger, on the evidence
heading: Containment Is Proved Row by Row: Each Weak Row Is a Sum of Strong Ones
cases: of two maximizing formulations, the one whose bound is never higher and sometimes lower is named
when minimizing, the formulation with the higher LP bound is the tighter one
two formulations that each give the tighter bound on a different objective are neither
formulations whose bounds are equal on every objective are the same, as far as the evidence goes
